newsitem.title: USA: Salomon starts bridge loan fund.
newsitem.headline: Salomon starts bridge loan fund.

text.p: Salomon Brothers, investment banking arm of Salomon Inc, said it has started a non-investment grade bridge loan fund to provide clients with access to short-term financing prior to the issuance of high yield securities.
Salomon said it has obtained more than $1.2 billion in commitments for the fund, known as The Millennium Fund.
Salomon said clients could tap the fund as a step in doing leveraged acquisitions, recapitalizations and management buyouts.

"By combining the fund with our advisory and loan syndications strength and our demonstrated expertise in the high yield bond market, we now offer clients a full menu of financial services, including different combinations of senior bank debt, high yield securitites, bridge financing, mergers & acquisitions advisory and other products," said Chad Leat, managing director in the high yield capital markets group and head of the fund.
